steps.caption: The selected UI motion option row reads Off.
steps.title: Turn motion Off

steps.caption: With UI motion Off, the header picture stays in its resting pose while the clock continues. Compare the waiting frames: readable values stay in place.
steps.title: Observe the still CLOCK miniature

steps.caption: With motion Off, playback sends C, D, E, F twice, then a final C before Stop. The first eight notes have their usual sixteenth-note lengths; Stop releases the final note early.
steps.title: Hear the same phrase with motion Off

steps.caption: The selected UI motion option row reads On.
steps.title: Turn motion On

steps.caption: With UI motion On, the header picture changes pose as the musical clock advances. The waiting frames show this decoration moving; it does not start playback.
steps.title: Observe the moving CLOCK miniature

steps.caption: With motion On, playback sends the same C, D, E, F phrase twice, then a final C before Stop. The first eight notes retain their usual lengths; Stop releases the final note early, just as with motion Off.
steps.title: Hear the same phrase with motion On

steps.caption: Compare Off and On: the same notes, velocities and note lengths play at the same musical times. Only the screen decoration changes.
steps.title: Compare complete Off and On MIDI

title: See screen motion in its pixels
